title: Calibrate a safety release gate
description: Use explicit synthetic evaluation counts to compare misses, safe interruptions, and review capacity. A failed critical gate cannot be averaged away.

scenarios.label: Public support assistant
scenarios.detail: A broad audience creates a low-prevalence safety triage problem.

operatingPoints.label: High recall
operatingPoints.detail: Catch more unsafe cases but interrupt more safe requests.

operatingPoints.label: Balanced evidence
operatingPoints.detail: Meets the declared quality gates in this synthetic fixture.

operatingPoints.label: Low alert volume
operatingPoints.detail: Protect the queue by accepting more unsafe misses.

scenarios.label: Internal research copilot
scenarios.detail: Rare sensitive-data failures make base-rate effects visible.

operatingPoints.label: High recall
operatingPoints.detail: Strong detection with a review queue dominated by false positives.

operatingPoints.label: Balanced evidence
operatingPoints.detail: The declared recall and interruption gates both pass.

operatingPoints.label: Low alert volume
operatingPoints.detail: A narrow alert stream hides too many unsafe cases.

scenarios.label: Tool-using operations agent
scenarios.detail: High-impact actions require both a strong detector and enough reviewers.

operatingPoints.label: High recall
operatingPoints.detail: Catch nearly every unsafe case but exceed the interruption gate.

operatingPoints.label: Balanced evidence
operatingPoints.detail: Exactly meets both declared quality gates.

operatingPoints.label: Low alert volume
operatingPoints.detail: A small queue comes at the cost of the critical recall gate.
